Quick summary of what we shared on the call:
- Primary use: multi-turn customer support assistant + document summarization for earnings calls
- Expected peak TPS: ~12 requests/sec (spiky around earnings)
- Typical concurrency during business hours: 180 concurrent conversations
- Average tokens: 1,100 input + 300 output = ~1,400 tokens per request (token mix attached)
- Model preference: high-quality 70B family, latency target ~300ms p95 for short prompts, willingness to trade-off some latency for cost using batching for longer requests
- Data sensitivity: customer PII and transaction data

Elena 


thanks for the snapshot and the clear numbers. Couple quick clarifying Qs before we run the initial capacity estimate:

1) TPS vs concurrency: you mentioned ~12 TPS peak but 180 concurrent conversations. Are those long-running conversations (many tokens per call) or short interactions? The snapshot helps but want to confirm how many active requests per second we should treat as sustained vs burst.

2) Token distribution: is the 1,400-token average weighted by all requests (i.e., most calls are long) or skewed by a smaller set of very long doc-summary requests? If you can give approximate percent split (e.g., 70% short <400 tokens, 20% medium 400-1,200, 10% long >1,200) that helps.

3) Model SLAs & deployment: do you need the Dedicated pool to be in a VPC/private deployment from day one? Or can we propose a staged approach (start hosted/dedicated hybrid, then migrate to Private VPC for production)?

Initial thoughts for sizing (high level):
- GPU candidates: NVIDIA H100 (best latency/throughput for 70B family) or A100-80GB (cost-effective for batch-heavy workloads). We'll size both and show cost tradeoffs.
- Batching & KV cache: For multi-turn chat, KV cache will reduce repeated compute for long conversations; effective concurrency may be lower after caching.
- Quantization: If you can tolerate FP16->4-bit or 8-bit quantization for some fallbacks, that can reduce GPU memory and increase throughput. We'll include quantization profiles in the recommendation.

Next steps I will take this week:
- Run two sizing scenarios (H100 vs A100) using the provided snapshot + two token-distribution assumptions
- Produce a capacity_estimate.xlsx & a recommended config (node counts, GPUs, estimated p95 latency, cost/Mo)
- Schedule a 30-min follow-up to review results 

are mornings PT on Thursday 5/6 or Friday 5/7 good for you?

Looping in Marissa and Rafael for pricing and Dedicated operational details.

Hi Aditya 


quick answers below so you can proceed:

1) Concurrency vs TPS: most of the 180 concurrent conversations are active short chats (average 6) during peaks. The long document summaries are less frequent (about 8–12% of requests) but drive the token average up. For sizing please assume sustained baseline TPS of 6 req/s with bursts to 18 req/s for ~10-minute windows during business hours.

2) Token distribution: approx 65% short (<400 tokens), 20% medium (400-1,200), 15% long (>1,200). The long ones are typically the earnings-call summarizations.

3) Deployment: compliance wants VPC/private for production but is open to a pilot on Dedicated (customer-managed isolated pool in Redwood's infra) before moving to private VPC. We prefer a staged approach.

Also note: retention & audit logs requirements 



SOC2 evidence and 90-day logs available. Elena can share the compliance questionnaire separately.
